insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware of this change, as it may affect their app's tax calculation logic. They should test their apps to ensure compatibility with this update. The GraphQL Admin API is affected, specifically the orderUpdate mutation. No migration is required, but developers should review their code to handle potential tax calculation changes.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses for unfulfilled orders, which can impact their order fulfillment and customer experience.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations, which is crucial for merchants to comply with tax regulations and avoid potential disputes with customers.

also_worth_knowing.text: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update provides more insights for merchants and developers.
The Shopify CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing the development experience. This update improves the debugging process for developers.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexibility in cart management. The updateCart action updates cart attributes, and a new event fires when an attribute update is initiated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented. This update affects inventory management and may require adjustments.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores. Agents can search catalogs, manage carts, and proceed to checkout on behalf of shoppers.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores. This update expands the deployment options for developers.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, providing more flexibility in order management. Developers can attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: The Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, reflecting how fulfillment operations work in practice. These changes make it easier for apps to achieve the Built for Shopify badge.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated, adding new capabilities to the toolkit and extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts. Vue bindings are now available, allowing developers to build storefronts in Vue with the same Hydrogen API.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. These fields offer more insights into cash management operations.

The Shopify CLI version 4.6.0 has removed deprecated draftable extension processes and dev session support branching, improving the development experience. New flags have been added to avoid prompts in app config linking.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making. This update enhances trust and security in collaborator access.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance performance data and storefront events

themes.title: ShopifyQL Updates
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL.

themes.title: Storefront and UI Extensions
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, with the updateCart standard action updating cart attributes and a new shopify:cart:attributes-update event firing whenever an attributes update is initiated. Additionally, UI extension source maps are now served during app development.
